public_definitions: The goal is to review the dashboard trend for physicians per 1,000 residents over the reporting period and route this record to the follow-up pathway that best fits the observed end-of-period capacity pattern.
The comparison scope is the trend in physician density over time, specifically from 2000 to 2017.5.
The rules are to base the routing decision on the observed end-of-period capacity pattern, using the provided options.
